extracted.name: Shipwreck Casserole
extracted.description: This shipwreck casserole turns easy ingredients like ground beef, macaroni and cheese, and frozen vegetables into a quick and easy kid-friendly dinner.
ingredient_lines: 1 (7.25 ounce) package macaroni and cheese mix
1 teaspoon seasoned salt (such as LAWRY'S®), or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Stir pasta and cheese mixture from macaroni and cheese package into beef. Stir in tomatoes, milk, peas, and corn; bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until noodles are tender, about 12 minutes.
Season with seasoned salt. Stir 1/2 of the Cheddar cheese into dish to melt. Top with remaining cheese.
